translations.web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
translations.bsb: Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.
translations.kjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
translations.asv: Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.
